findings_validity.detail: All five standing findings (F-001..F-005) carry real expected_basis grounded in public docs (app/README.md), the product's own usage/help surface, or internal state contradictions (UTF-8 disk vs GBK stdout; save-strict vs show-lenient argparse) — none preference-driven. Reproduction evidence exists on disk for every finding and matches the reported transcripts: F-001 (high, confirmed) reproduced twice from clean state in two independent phases (evidence/j5-edges.md, evidence/compare-c3-bare-save-delta.txt, 19->0 bytes with false 'Saved OK'); F-002 backed by byte-level dual captures (j4-show-rawbytes.bin, compare-c4-show-rawbytes.bin) plus a cp1252 crash traceback; F-005 reproduced twice. Severities are reasonable: destructive bare-save graded high not critical (requires malformed invocation, single-note store); encoding defect graded medium (presentation-layer, data intact); low items justified. The two observer-side false positives (300-char 'truncation', wrong evidence path) were disproven with byte evidence and annotated in place, not suppressed. F-004 is correctly held as owner-decision, not silently closed. No dismissal relies on an implementer assertion.

coverage_adequacy.detail: Product map covers every README-documented entrance (save/show) in BOTH documented invocation forms (C6 cwd=app 'python app.py' vs packet form 'python app/app.py', with cross-form storage continuity) plus the undocumented --smoke surface discovered via the product's own usage line, cold start, overwrite semantics, unicode, whitespace/300-char notes, and error paths (bare invocation, unknown subcommand, extra args per command, unquoted multi-word). Not happy-paths-only. Disappearance hunting was performed against the immediately preceding round (C2 help-surface re-bind; D1/D2/D8 deltas), and the compare explicitly hunted and found a user-impact regression (D3: cand-bad silent no-op bare save -> cand-fix destructive success) rather than excusing it as a side effect of the fix. Baseline honesty: the declared 'cand-good' ref was found missing and recorded explicitly instead of silently assumed; compare fell back to the cand-bad round artifacts, which exist with evidence. Unobserved areas (multi-line notes, external edits, >300-char notes, concurrency) are recorded rather than assumed N/A; none is a material entrance promised by the goal or README.
